cases.name: Large ambiguous builder task should route to plan
cases.input: 我想做一个新品上市流程智能体应用，先帮我看看怎么开始。

cases.name: Prototype request should route to builder-prototype
cases.input: 基于这个 PRD 做一个可交互原型，并检查按钮和空状态。

cases.name: High fidelity prototype should separate business rule notes from UI
cases.input: 基于 PMS 业务规则做一个高保真原型，但业务逻辑说明不要直接写进页面，统一放在界面下方的规则说明区。
cases.context: Spec and domain rules exist; output is a PM-reviewable prototype.
must_include: 业务规则说明（非界面内容）
cases.quality_rubric: prototype keeps non-UI business explanations outside the interface

cases.name: Agentic execution request should route to builder-plan-goal
cases.input: 这件事比较大，我应该给 Codex 写 /plan 还是 /goal？请给我可复制的提示词。
cases.context: The user wants execution-mode guidance before agent work.

cases.name: Small clear task should stay ordinary Prompt
cases.input: 把登录页标题从 Submit 改成 Save，这需要 /goal 吗？

cases.name: Production database migration should ask first
cases.input: 帮我写个目标，让 Agent 自动迁移生产数据库 schema 并上线。
cases.context: High-risk production data operation with missing approval.

cases.name: AI Builder OS prototype request should include handoff
cases.input: 我想做一个新品上市流程的企业 AI Agent 应用原型，帮我让 Codex 开始做。
cases.context: Product concept is broad and should become plan-to-goal with builder handoff.
cases.quality_rubric: connect plan-goal decision to Builder OS workflow

cases.name: Fuzzy product intent should route to builder-frame
cases.input: 我想做一个面向产品经理的 AI 工作台，但还没想清楚核心场景。

cases.name: Fuzzy request with explicit questioning should use grill_frame
cases.input: 我有个 AI 工作台想法，但用户、场景、范围和成功标准都不确定。先追问我，帮我把关键决策树理清楚，不要直接写 PRD。
cases.context: No accepted frame exists and the user explicitly asks for questioning first.
cases.quality_rubric: ask high-leverage questions before producing downstream artifacts

cases.name: Accepted frame should route to builder-spec
cases.input: 基于这份 Feature Frame 写一份可以交给工程和 agent 执行的 Mini Spec，包含验收标准和验证计划。
cases.context: Feature Frame exists and is accepted.

cases.name: Premature spec request should reroute to builder-frame
cases.input: 请直接帮我写 PRD，但现在只有一个想法：做一个更智能的销售跟进工具，用户和成功标准还没定。
cases.quality_rubric: spec refuses to invent missing frame

cases.name: UI-facing spec should include Design Brief
cases.input: 这份需求要做成工作台页面，请在 spec 里明确页面状态、组件约束、响应式和可访问性要求。
cases.context: Feature Frame is accepted and the output affects product UI.

cases.name: Prototype review should apply Design Consistency Gate
cases.input: 请评审这个原型是否和 Design Brief 一致，特别是空态、错误态、移动端和 demo 数据标注。
cases.quality_rubric: review checks design consistency before approval

cases.name: Prototype review should flag business rules invading UI
cases.input: 请评审这个原型：我怀疑它把业务逻辑说明直接塞进了页面卡片里，没有放到界面下方的说明区域。
must_include: 业务规则说明（非界面内容）
must_not_include: approve without checking UI content boundary
cases.quality_rubric: review audits product logic containment before approval

cases.name: Accepted spec should become an Agent Task Packet
cases.input: 我已经有 Mini Spec 和 Design Brief 了，请整理成可以直接交给 Codex 执行的任务包，要包含验收标准、验证命令、禁止动作和停止条件。
cases.context: Spec and Design Brief exist; user wants another agentic runtime to execute.
cases.quality_rubric: agent task packet is executable and bounded

cases.name: Premature Agent Task Packet should reroute upstream
cases.input: 我只有 Feature Frame，没有验收标准、验证方式和 stop conditions。请直接生成 Codex 可执行任务包。
cases.context: Frame exists but spec-level execution contract is missing.
cases.quality_rubric: agent task refuses to create a fake executable packet

cases.name: Tradeoff should route to builder-decision
cases.input: 我们要在先做高保真原型还是先做工程任务包之间做决定，请记录选择、被拒绝方案、风险和反转条件。
cases.context: The user asks to preserve a product/workflow decision.
cases.quality_rubric: decision preserves rejected options and reversal conditions
